entities.name: Jiří Hanzelka
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jiří Hanzelka and Miroslav Zikmund, known collectively as Hanzelka and Zikmund, were a duo of Czech adventurers known for their travels in Africa, Asia, Latin America, and Oceania in the 1940s and 1950s, and for the books, articles, and films they created about their journeys.
